events.text: Leak detector LD-23-04 alarm triggered. Zone L23-Zone-04. Cable-type sensor, ceiling void above L22 tenant ceiling. Alarm class: brick:Leak_Alarm.

location.value: L23 ceiling void / L22 tenant ceiling above

events.text: AHU-23-01 chilled-water supply/return ΔT anomaly: supply 6.5°C, return 7.1°C (expected ΔT ~6°C, actual ΔT 0.6°C). Possible CHW flow bypass or leak at AHU-23-01 supply branch.

Call from Straits Meridian Bank facilities desk (L22): 'Water dripping from ceiling grid above workstations near core area, trading floor not affected yet. Please send someone.' Caller: bank facilities coordinator.

CMMS work order WO-2026-1011-0347 raised. Priority: P1. Asset: AHU-23-01 + CHW riser R2 L23 branch. Assigned to: Technical Services on-duty technician. Description: 'Investigate leak alarm LD-23-04 and AHU ΔT anomaly. Potential CHW supply branch leak.'

On-site technician arrived L23 mechanical riser. Visual: water pooling on AHU-23-01 supply branch insulation, dripping down through ceiling void toward L22. Source appears to be CHW supply branch coupling at AHU-23-01 inlet. Water category: Category 1 (clean chilled water).

Technician photo metadata: IMG_20261011_080800.jpg. Location: L23 riser, AHU-23-01 supply branch. EXIF: 08:08:00 SGT. Shows water on insulation jacket and drip pattern. Uploaded to CMMS WO-2026-1011-0347.

Critical observation: water tracking along ceiling void conduit toward L23 Electrical Riser Cupboard. Water within approximately 1.5 m of Distribution Board DB-23A. Not yet in contact with DB-23A. Floor dry outside cupboard.

Isolation sub-valve ISV-L23-CHW closed (CHW branch isolation for Riser R2 at L23). Flow to AHU-23-01 supply branch stopped. Valve tagged. Time of isolation logged. Upstream riser valve CHW-R2-V-L23 left open — only local branch isolated.
Chief Engineer Tan Wei Ming notified Duty Manager and Head of Technical Services Goh Boon Kheng. AOM Priya Nair notified via CMMS escalation rule. Water near DB-23A flagged for LEW dispatch.

MOSAIC engine evaluation: Rule TS-07 (v1.2) triggered — water near electrical (DB-23A within 1.5 m). Action 'Re-energise affected AHU / DB' blocked. Missing evidence: lew_signoff, insulation_resistance_ok, area_dry. Escalate to: duty_lew (Rahul Menon), fallback: head_technical_services. Provenance: ce-interview-2026-10-02#00:14:32.

Duty LEW Rahul Menon dispatched to site. ETA 25 min (08:39). Task: inspect DB-23A and surrounding area for moisture ingress, perform insulation resistance test, certify safe / not safe for re-energisation.

Straits Meridian Bank facilities coordinator follow-up: 'Drip has stopped but ceiling tiles are saturated. Trading floor L20-L26 requesting status update. Do we need to evacuate?' AOM Priya Nair responding.
Moisture meter reading at DB-23A cupboard threshold: 18% (ambient baseline 12%). No water inside cupboard. Drip tray deployed at ceiling void entry point. Area cordoned. AHU-23-01 remains isolated.

Insulation resistance test pending LEW arrival. DB-23A remains energised but access restricted. No re-energisation of AHU-23-01 circuit until LEW signs off. AOM drafting first-notice tenant message (30-min SLA first notice clock started at 08:04 tenant call).
